title: Fix Azure/OpenAI endpoints and reject Azure AI Inference URLs
author: Neonsy
lessons: Fail fast for unsupported configurations -- reject Azure AI Inference upfront instead of path hacks
URL normalization is a minefield -- aggressive /v1 appending can break custom proxy endpoints
Auth varies by Azure endpoint type -- centralizing auth logic in a single method is the right pattern
Community confirmation on real Azure deployments provides stronger signal than mock tests
Provider divergence (openai vs openai-responses) needs cross-reference in error messages
